derivation: feminine of a compound of G4012 (περί) and G2776 (κεφαλή);
def: encirclement of the head, i.e. a helmet

occurrences.text: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
